path.name: Cliff Path
path.description: A narrow path climbs the cliff toward a white tower. Far below, waves boom against the rocks.

base.name: Lighthouse Base
base.description: A round room with whitewashed walls. Oilskins hang on pegs, and a spiral stair climbs into the dark.

description.text: The great lamp blazes, and its beam sweeps out across the black water.
Glass on every side, and the sea beyond it. The great lamp in the middle is cold and dark.

rooms.name: #shore_adj.title# Shore
rooms.description: Shingle crunches underfoot and gulls wheel overhead. The sea smells of salt and weed.

rooms.name: Dune Path
rooms.description: A sandy path winds between dunes held together by marram grass.

lighthouse_relight.title: The Dark Lamp
lighthouse_relight.hook: The lamp at {beat.area} has gone dark, and ships are breaking on the rocks.
lighthouse_relight.intro: If the lamp at {beat.area} stays dark, more ships will die on the rocks.
lighthouse_relight.hint: Help {beat.keeper.name} relight the great lamp at {beat.area}.
rumor: The light at {beat.area} went out a week ago. The keeper's too old to climb the stair with oil.
lighthouse_relight.complete_text: The beam swings out over the sea. Far off, a ship's bell answers.

lighthouse_keeper.name: Keeper #given#
lighthouse_keeper.appearance: {self.Name} sits by the stove, rubbing a swollen knee.

do: "Bless you," says {self.name}. "The ships will see us now."
"My knees won't take that stair any more," {self.name} says. "Take a can of oil up to the lamp, would you?"

oil_cask.name: oil cask
oil_cask.appearance: A cask of lamp oil stands by the door.
oil_cask.contents_text: On top of the cask sits {contents}.

oil_can.name: can of lamp oil
oil_can.description: A dented tin can, full and sloshing.

great_lamp.name: great lamp
great_lamp.description: A brass lamp the size of a cart wheel, inside a great glass lens.

do: You fill the reservoir, trim the wick and strike a light. The great lamp roars into life.
The reservoir is bone dry. It needs oil.
You pour in the oil and light the wick. The great lamp roars into life.
